title: American Airlines: Airline Customer Service Dashboard
summary: DOT's dashboard records airline commitments for controllable cancellations and delays. Phase 56E entity use: The same operating-carrier annual denominator shows a higher cancellation rate in both later years; the May 2026 on-time and dashboard records remain separate.
key_findings: The dashboard provides a stated-commitment layer for American, Alaska, and JetBlue that can be kept separate from measured operating outcomes.
Entity layer: American Airlines operating-carrier domestic scheduled service.
Compatibility boundary: Same carrier identity; annual cancellations, monthly on-time arrivals, and commitments use different denominators.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: A stated commitment does not verify passenger eligibility, delivery of a remedy, complaint resolution, or overall service performance.
Official DOT compilation; carrier-reported cause and commitment information remains attributed.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
